task: Vite and React landing for a fictional instrument workshop. One display face, one text face, paper or ink, no purple gradient, no row of three equal cards. Build must pass. The page needs a title, one sentence, and a contact line.

arms.orchestra: one short DESIGN.md, then the task

builds: npm run build exited 0 on all six workspaces

judge.method: A fresh judge saw shuffled desktop and mobile screenshots, labeled A and B, plus the brief. The map was applied after the verdict.
judge.summary: Two trials preferred the Orchestra page. One trial was a tie. Performance averages were 98 for the raw arm and 97 for the Orchestra arm. Accessibility was 100 and axe found nothing on every arm.

note: Both arms met the acceptance line. The sample is three trials on one small page. compare.go stays disabled and the claim stays none.
